edits.old: No approval level from the delegation of authority applies in this story; approval of the notice itself is RWB-P3-E2014-APP and RWB-P6-E2021-APP.
edits.new:
No approval level from the delegation of authority applies in this story; approval of the notice itself is RWB-P3-E2014-APP and RWB-P6-E2021-APP. The notice approval is held in the ApprovalWorkflow of rwb-decision as a child of NoticeDispatchWorkflow, with the notice as its source; POST /notices/{noticeId}/approve of rwb-litigation is the litigation officer's decision point; the notice waits in Approved and is not written to the file (GAP-2093).

Each REST operation of this story is authorised by the rwb-access authorise check of DP-08 for the role that calls it; the check's identifier is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P3-E2021-APP-6).
